### Foods and Drinks to Limit or Avoid

- **Alcohol:** Alcohol stresses and scars the liver; avoiding or strictly limiting it is essential for liver protection.
- **Added sugars and sugary drinks:** Sodas, sweetened teas, candies, and baked goods promote fat buildup in the liver.
- **Saturated fats, fried foods, and excess salt:** Fast food, fatty cuts of red meat, processed snacks, and high-sodium sauces can worsen liver inflammation and fluid retention.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXyyvxBzhypPlID0HK-iHlHMWaPKO_tkeubNeRLylZkc4qTBYJOvyXoIktfqQa55_0eGWiNx_dwy7yPYQ7fGQvhRPJ0YFX6kceTgXtNaj-CGeTko0FJcAoDc2NYkuzX4AY81gknmZ0xnHTc_0aPf4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF19YVna7iANq1we8mKU8zSPvkydMJR4JNrFXmptrefObNhzpATt3P96BSklK48aKPlm0f_FWYW4PWSoJ-G3WgsnY0MKpUT2GTdCvpyQntPNq6ozBeVgRyjAv1TiJLCbmueVyKJC6NGTjn0MhSPmWlWqjE88akA0QsnJfXGocMHYtaD-_Ol0MfhxtFD7OoWWA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXxPK89Gq9Jitoa_tpRyKKK7o4L7KH7b-VDuWnY7DnkKCSmhuF33qdvdB0JZVTxap16uH2pzBREIvEvql-R_dAuLpUy9Iayo1IHl7Oe6pt4dy6dD5sE1vGkw_7y8YffLn6YGxzAvkJgGpqHwQZK31sjaH3gcsv1RwbGCg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1-1fVaiaQBCuHQqWqeTuu2bahrgpcj74RD_IZKA3mxLmHB7MAtB87qnYjUHvkxBjODxpo6ek1DQCYJHeIsQP-ON1QikwqA81qcqbIcQPHIYBceseda5onoqQ_kEjC3iR5plluugUwlnM317LxxCoG5FLyq2mpilci6-IMMtW6ePCQPRwM7tNG7vdMrRLkI8A1uBV)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXN6RyAK6SlAZo1oCouGxf-8MOwWy6VcogcL_BDeYFOApezpXULN_szG2pmClWemLXNh_hSR_KumqaGwOSSxMiehmeYETRYd_SsGYc-r6ZMQmnZPHf5VHLRXn_ALqDwmLGu2Z13KYCvxtRDtVufGGJgVI2lFM)

Always consult a doctor before taking supplements, as they are not tightly regulated and some can actually harm the liver.
